apps.name: Portainer
apps.description: Web UI to manage Docker containers, images, volumes and stacks, with its own app templates.
apps.notes: Create the admin user within 5 minutes after the start.
apps.compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:lts
    container_name: portainer
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
      - "9000:9000"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.description: Open source home automation: devices, dashboards and automations.
apps.compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    container_name: homeassistant
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: AdGuard Home
apps.description: Network wide ads and trackers blocking DNS server.
apps.notes: Setup wizard on port 3000, afterwards web UI on port 3080. DNS listens on port 5335: in Network -> DHCP and DNS -> Forwards set 127.0.0.1#5335.
apps.compose:
services:
  adguardhome:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    container_name: adguardhome
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5335:53/udp"
      - "5335:53/tcp"
      - "3000:3000/tcp"
      - "3080:80/tcp"
    volumes:
      - ./work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf

apps.name: Nextcloud
apps.description: Personal cloud: files, calendar, contacts, photos.
apps.notes: Put the data on a big disk: expand the root filesystem or edit the volume path.
apps.compose:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:apache
    container_name: nextcloud
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8081:80"
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./html:/var/www/html

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: Media server for movies, series and music.
apps.notes: Media files: /opt/docker-apps/jellyfin/media (or edit the volume to your disk).
apps.compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ./media:/media

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.description: Continuous file synchronization between devices.
apps.compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    container_name: syncthing
    hostname: khadas-edge
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8384:8384"
      - "22000:22000/tcp"
      - "22000:22000/udp"
      - "21027:21027/udp"
    environment:
      - PUID=0
      - PGID=0
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/syncthing

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Bitwarden compatible password manager server.
apps.notes: Browsers allow the web vault only over HTTPS: use it behind Nginx Proxy Manager or a VPN.
apps.compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8082:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Monitoring of websites, services and devices with notifications.
apps.compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data

apps.name: File Browser
apps.description: Web file manager: upload, download, share files.
apps.notes: User admin, the initial password is printed in the logs.
apps.compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    container_name: filebrowser
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "0:0"
    ports:
      - "8083:80"
    volumes:
      - ./files:/srv
      - ./database:/database
      - ./config:/config

apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.description: BitTorrent client with web UI.
apps.notes: User admin, the temporary password is printed in the logs.
apps.compose:
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
    environment:
      - PUID=0
      - PGID=0
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - WEBUI_PORT=8084
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./downloads:/downloads

apps.name: Transmission
apps.description: Lightweight BitTorrent client with web UI.
apps.compose:
services:
  transmission:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/transmission:latest
    container_name: transmission
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
      - "51413:51413"
      - "51413:51413/udp"
    environment:
      - PUID=0
      - PGID=0
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./downloads:/downloads
      - ./watch:/watch

apps.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.description: Reverse proxy with free Let's Encrypt certificates and web UI.
apps.notes: Ports 80/443 are used by LuCI, the proxy listens on 8880/8443 (forward 80/443 from your router).
apps.compose:
services:
  nginx-proxy-manager:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    container_name: nginx-proxy-manager
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8880:80"
      - "8443:443"
      - "81:81"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

apps.name: Node-RED
apps.description: Flow based programming for IoT and automations.
apps.compose:
services:
  node-red:
    image: nodered/node-red:latest
    container_name: node-red
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "0:0"
    ports:
      - "1880:1880"
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

apps.name: Mosquitto
apps.description: MQTT broker for IoT devices.
apps.notes: No authentication: MQTT on port 1883 for the local network.
apps.compose:
services:
  mosquitto:
    image: eclipse-mosquitto:latest
    container_name: mosquitto
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: mosquitto -c /mosquitto-no-auth.conf
    ports:
      - "1883:1883"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/mosquitto/data

apps.name: Grafana
apps.description: Dashboards and graphs for metrics.
apps.compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:latest
    container_name: grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "0:0"
    ports:
      - "3002:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/grafana

apps.name: Homepage
apps.description: Start page / dashboard for all your services.
apps.compose:
services:
  homepage:

    container_name: dozzle
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:

    volumes:

apps.name: WireGuard Easy
apps.description: WireGuard VPN server with web UI and QR codes for clients.
apps.notes: For clients from the internet allow UDP 51820 from WAN (Docker blocks WAN by default: Services -> Docker -> blocked interfaces).
apps.compose:
services:
  wg-easy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:15
    container_name: wg-easy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - INSECURE=true
    ports:
      - "51820:51820/udp"
      - "51821:51821/tcp"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/wireguard
      - /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1

apps.name: code-server

apps.notes: The password is in /opt/docker-apps/code-server/config/.config/code-server/config.yaml or set PASSWORD in the compose file.

    ports:

    environment:
      - PUID=0
      - PGID=0
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
